challenge.en: A PhysicsNeMo training workflow for data-center heat-flow simulation spent much of its time with the GPU waiting for data.
challenge.zh-TW: 資料中心熱流模擬的 PhysicsNeMo 訓練流程中，GPU 有大量時間在等待資料。

solution.en: Scoped the OpenFOAM data-generation dependency, traced the slowdown to the demo's data-format loader, set the optimization direction, and reviewed a Claude-assisted loader rewrite.
solution.zh-TW: 釐清 OpenFOAM 資料生成的依賴，把瓶頸定位到範例的資料格式載入器，決定最佳化方向，並審查 Claude 協助完成的載入器改寫。

boundary.en: Changed how training data was loaded; the OpenFOAM solver and model architecture were left as they were.
boundary.zh-TW: 改的是訓練資料的載入方式；OpenFOAM 求解器與模型架構維持原樣。

aInput.en: GPU idle time during CFD surrogate training
aInput.zh-TW: CFD 代理模型訓練期間 GPU 閒置

weakestLink.en: The demo's loader for the simulation data format
weakestLink.zh-TW: 範例中模擬資料格式的載入器

bOutput.en: Shorter overall training and data-streaming time, with less GPU idle time
bOutput.zh-TW: 整體訓練與資料串流耗時縮短，GPU 閒置減少

strictInvariant.en: A low training loss is not evidence of a useful model unless the simulation data behind it is physically correct.
strictInvariant.zh-TW: 模擬資料本身未確認正確前，訓練 loss 低不代表模型可用。

en: Buying more GPUs to hide a data-loading stall
zh-TW: 以增購 GPU 掩蓋資料載入的停頓

failureConditions.en: If the simulation's initial-to-final states are not physically plausible, training speed is irrelevant; that check comes first, and a heat-flow specialist should confirm the data.
failureConditions.zh-TW: 若模擬從初始到終止狀態不符合物理常理，訓練再快也沒有意義；這項檢查優先，資料正確性應由熱流專家確認。

challenger.en: Why not add GPUs or rent a larger cluster?
challenger.zh-TW: 為什麼不直接加 GPU 或租更大的叢集？

defense.en: The GPU was already waiting for data. More GPUs would wait too. The limiting stage was the loader, so that is where the change went.
defense.zh-TW: GPU 已經在等資料，加更多 GPU 也只是一起等。限速的是載入器，所以改動放在那裡。

challenger.en: A Claude agent wrote the loader change. What was your part?
challenger.zh-TW: 載入器是 Claude agent 改寫的，那你做了什麼？

defense.en: I defined the scope, found which stage was slow, chose the direction, and checked that training time and GPU idle time actually dropped. I also raised with several managers, up to the CTO, that the simulation data needed review by a heat-flow specialist before the model could be trusted.
defense.zh-TW: 我界定範圍、找出慢在哪一段、決定方向，並確認訓練時間與 GPU 閒置確實下降。我也向多位主管（包括 CTO 層級）提出，模型可信之前，模擬資料需要熱流專家確認。

staff.en: Finding the stage that limited training
staff.zh-TW: 找出限制訓練速度的那一段

coreQuestion.en: Is a slow training run a model problem or a data-path problem?
coreQuestion.zh-TW: 訓練慢，是模型的問題，還是資料路徑的問題？

breakthrough.en: Traced GPU idle time to the simulation-data loader and set the direction for a Claude-assisted rewrite.
breakthrough.zh-TW: 把 GPU 閒置追到模擬資料載入器，並決定 Claude 協助改寫的方向。

verifiedMoat.en: Overall training time, data-streaming time, and GPU idle time dropped after the loader change.
verifiedMoat.zh-TW: 載入器改寫後，整體訓練、資料串流耗時與 GPU 閒置都下降。

em.zh-TW: 瓶頸診斷與程式修改審查

coreQuestion.en: How do you use an AI coding agent without losing control of the result?
coreQuestion.zh-TW: 使用 AI coding agent 時，如何仍掌握結果？

breakthrough.en: Kept problem definition, direction, and acceptance with the engineer; the agent made the code change.
breakthrough.zh-TW: 問題定義、方向與驗收由工程師負責，程式修改由 agent 執行。

verifiedMoat.en: Raised the data-validation risk to management instead of reporting a fast model as a finished one.
verifiedMoat.zh-TW: 向主管提出資料驗證風險，而不是把訓練變快當成完成。

recruiter.en: Physics background applied to an unfamiliar ML domain
recruiter.zh-TW: 物理背景應用於陌生的 ML 領域

coreQuestion.en: How quickly can Blake become useful in an unfamiliar domain?
coreQuestion.zh-TW: Blake 進入陌生領域後，多快能有產出？

breakthrough.en: Learned OpenFOAM data generation and PhysicsNeMo training, then built and adapted a Morpheus PCAP anomaly workflow, each within about a month.
breakthrough.zh-TW: 學會 OpenFOAM 資料生成與 PhysicsNeMo 訓練，也建立並調整 Morpheus PCAP 異常偵測流程，各約一個月內完成。

verifiedMoat.en: Two working workflows, documented and handed off.
verifiedMoat.zh-TW: 兩條可運作的流程，已文件化並完成交接。

en.result: GPU idle time traced to the loader

Ran and adapted PhysicsNeMo training for an OpenFOAM data-center heat-flow use case.
Raised that the simulation data needed review by a heat-flow specialist before the model could be trusted.
en.boundary: The agent made the code change; problem definition, direction, and acceptance were mine.

zh-TW.result: GPU 閒置定位到資料載入器
details: 使用真實 PCAP 封包輸入，建立並調整 Nvidia Morpheus 網路異常偵測流程。
針對 OpenFOAM 資料中心熱流案例，執行並調整 PhysicsNeMo 訓練流程。
提出模型可信之前，模擬資料需要熱流專家確認。
zh-TW.boundary: 程式修改由 agent 執行；問題定義、方向與驗收由我負責。
